Dim red dwarf system gifted to Cheng Xin by Yun Tianming in Death’s End, orbiting two terrestrial worlds (Planet Blue and Planet Gray) where Cheng Xin and Guan Yifan experience curvature-propulsion death lines.
Lush, habitable exomoon of the gas giant Polyphemus in the Alpha Centauri A system; home of the Na’vi and source of unobtanium.
Blue-and-violet gas giant orbiting in the habitable zone of Alpha Centauri A, orbited by fourteen moons including Pandora.
Demolition orders for Earth were on display in the local planning department at Alpha Centauri for fifty Earth years.

gaia-5853498713190525696.x: Major Earth Alliance colony world in the Proxima Centauri system that declared independence during President Clark’s regime.
First extrasolar human colony world, orbiting Alpha Centauri; occupied and strip-mined by the felinoid Kzinti during the First Man-Kzin War.
Sprawling capital city of the United Colonies on planet Jemison in Alpha Centauri, headquarters of Constellation and MAST.
Nearest star system and final destination of Earth’s 100-generation interstellar journey propelled by massive fusion thrusters.
Orbital transfer terminal at Alpha Centauri where 75-year-old human recruits leave Earth behind to receive genetically augmented clone bodies.
Target of the Breakthrough Starshot relativistic laser-sail nanocraft concept and the 1988 USNA/NASA Project Longshot nuclear-pulse study.
Nearest stellar system and subject of intensive Breakthrough Listen monitoring, including the BLC1 candidate narrowband radio detection.

gaia-5853498713190525696.x: Sub-Earth candidate orbiting Proxima Centauri every 5.1 days at just 4.25 light-years, one of the lightest known extrasolar planets.
Closest known extrasolar planet in a habitable zone, orbiting Sol’s nearest stellar neighbor at 4.25 light-years under extreme stellar flare irradiation.
